title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=sin^2\left(\pi x\right)$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{1-0}{6}=\frac{1}{6}$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$0$$, $$\frac{1}{6}$$, $$\frac{1}{3}$$, $$0.5$$, $$\frac{2}{3}$$, $$\frac{5}{6}$$ and $$1$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$T_6=\frac{1}{12} \left(f{\left(0\right)}+2f{\left(\frac{1}{6}\right)}+2f{\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)}+2f{\left(0.5\right)}+2f{\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)}+2f{\left(\frac{5}{6}\right)}+f{\left(1\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$0.5$$.
